aggregate_accounting: Report all25cell totals, original G exact, G_prime exact, SCC-resolved beyond G_prime, remaining unresolved with deterministic reasons, and interval nesting. Preserve original records and refined bounds.
analysis: Bernoulli complete-sample SCC replay and statistical analysis
authority: Original Protocol_Baseline.json plus explicitly post-run Bound_Refinement_Protocol.json; Bernoulli adds SCC localization and statistical displays without changing sampled networks.

certificate_events.failure_intervals: Pointwise two-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson intervals, including zero counts.
certificate_events.improvement: Report paired rescued count G^c intersect G_prime, its fraction of all draws, and conditional fraction among original G failures with denominator stated.
certificate_events.paired_invariant: Check G implies G_prime on every draw.

design.unresolved_costs: Retain every certified integer [lower,upper] interval; never impute a midpoint or use resolved-only statistics.

empirical_cdf_discrepancy.interpretation: Deterministic complete-sample CDF discrepancy bounds, not total variation and not a population confidence interval.

failure_scaling.interpretation: Descriptive finite-size slopes; sampling variability and preasymptotic behavior do not establish an asymptotic rate or prefactor.
failure_scaling.local_slopes: log(p_hat(n2)/p_hat(n1))/log(n2/n1) for each adjacent size pair and the prespecified spans100to1600 and1600to25600.
failure_scaling.scaled_rates: n times observed G and G_prime failure rates, with both CP endpoints multiplied by n.
failure_scaling.zero_counts: Report slope unavailable if either count is zero; do not add pseudocounts.

largest_size_pmf.computational_bounds: Definite membership when the whole cost interval lies in a bin; possible membership when it intersects a bin.
largest_size_pmf.display: Empirical probability minus fixed reference Poisson probability; distinguish computational range from sampling envelope.
largest_size_pmf.sampling_envelope: Same CP outer envelope from definite and possible counts; pointwise, not simultaneous across bins or cells.

mean_and_second_raw_moment.computational_bounds: For j=1,2, average lower^j and upper^j over all M draws.
mean_and_second_raw_moment.coverage_language: Approximate pointwise 95% outer envelope from two one-sided endpoint normal bounds; not an exact finite-sample confidence interval. Ordinary cost or cost-squared SE is reported only when every cost in that cell is resolved.
mean_and_second_raw_moment.endpoint_standard_errors: Sample standard deviation with denominator M-1, divided by sqrt(M), computed separately for lower^j and upper^j.

parameter_comparison.planned_contrast: A and B both have lambda_unweighted0.6 and mu_unweighted0.9162907, versus weighted lambda0.4/0.8 and mu0.5108256/1.6094379.
parameter_comparison.unweighted: lambda_unweighted=2*E(q); report mu_unweighted=-log(1-lambda_unweighted) only when lambda_unweighted<1, otherwise outside subcritical domain.

pooled_tail_pearson.binning: Singleton bins0,...,K-1 and tailK+, with largest K such that every expected bin count is at least5. Binning depends only on M and fixed reference mu, never observed costs.
pooled_tail_pearson.decision_at_0_05: Reject for every compatible completion only if p_upper<0.05; fail to reject for every completion if p_lower>=0.05; otherwise mark computationally unresolved.
pooled_tail_pearson.degrees_of_freedom: Number of bins minus1; no parameter fitted.
pooled_tail_pearson.interpretation: Approximate pointwise goodness-of-fit diagnostics for all 25 cells. No pooled-across-cell test or multiple-testing population claim.
pooled_tail_pearson.null: Exact finite-n Poisson distribution with mu=-log(1-lambda); mu is not fitted.
pooled_tail_pearson.resolved_cells: Ordinary Pearson statistic and approximate chi-square survival probability.
pooled_tail_pearson.unresolved_cells: For each bin bound its count by definite and possible membership. Lower statistic is the sum of minimum squared standardized deviations over each real count interval; upper statistic is the sum of endpoint maxima. These are conservative outer bounds, potentially loose because cross-bin allocation constraints are ignored.

zero_cost_probability.sampling_envelope: [lower endpoint of two-sided95% Clopper-Pearson interval for definite count, upper endpoint for possible count]. Monotonicity contains the latent complete-sample exact-count CP interval and therefore gives at least95% pointwise coverage.
